name: Sample Mystic
title: Natal birth chart

paragraphs: The Sun describes a way of developing confidence and expressing a coherent sense of self. Its sign suggests the qualities you may practice as you become more comfortable choosing your own direction.

In Scorpio, Sun's themes of identity and vitality are expressed through depth, emotional honesty and an interest in what lies beneath the surface. In house 8 (Shared resources & change), consider how this relates to shared finances, trust, intimacy and experiences of release or transition.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

The Moon symbolizes familiar responses, sources of comfort and the rhythms that help you feel at home. Its sign offers a vocabulary for emotional needs; it is not a diagnosis or a fixed description of how you must feel.

In Virgo, Moon's themes of emotional needs and habitual responses are expressed through discernment, practical care and the desire to improve what you encounter. In house 6 (Daily life & care), consider how this relates to routines, work habits, useful service and the practical ways you care for yourself.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

Mercury describes how you gather information, make connections and put experience into words. Its placement can be a useful prompt for considering which kinds of conversation, study and decision making suit you.

In Scorpio, Mercury's themes of communication and learning are expressed through depth, emotional honesty and an interest in what lies beneath the surface. In house 8 (Shared resources & change), consider how this relates to shared finances, trust, intimacy and experiences of release or transition.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.
Venus symbolizes attraction, enjoyment and the values that guide relationship choices. Consider both what feels beautiful to you and how you negotiate giving, receiving and mutual respect.

In Libra, Venus's themes of values, connection and pleasure are expressed through cooperation, aesthetic balance and attention to fairness between people. In house 7 (Partnerships), consider how this relates to one-to-one relationships, agreements, collaboration and the negotiation of differences.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.
Mars describes the expression of effort and desire: how you begin, pursue a goal and respond to friction. Its symbolism can help you distinguish a clear boundary from an impulsive reaction.

In Virgo, Mars's themes of initiative, desire and boundaries are expressed through discernment, practical care and the desire to improve what you encounter. In house 6 (Daily life & care), consider how this relates to routines, work habits, useful service and the practical ways you care for yourself.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

Jupiter points to the search for possibility, learning and a larger sense of meaning. Its gifts are easier to use when enthusiasm is accompanied by realistic limits rather than assumptions that every opportunity will work out.

In Capricorn, Jupiter's themes of growth, meaning and opportunity are expressed through patience, responsibility and a commitment to making plans tangible. In house 10 (Vocation & public life), consider how this relates to public responsibilities, career direction and the contribution you want others to recognize.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

Saturn symbolizes skills developed through repetition, boundaries and the responsibilities you choose to carry. This placement can describe an area where confidence grows gradually as you gain experience.

In Aries, Saturn's themes of structure, limits and commitment are expressed through directness, initiative and the willingness to begin before everything is certain. In house 1 (Self & first impressions), consider how this relates to how you approach unfamiliar situations, present yourself and begin acting on your own behalf.

Retrograde means the planet appeared to move backward along the zodiac from Earth. Symbolically, you might explore a more reflective or personally defined relationship with these themes; it does not mean the planet is physically moving backward.

Uranus is associated with departures from habit and the wish to do things differently. Because it moves slowly, its sign is shared by many people; its house is more specific to the birth time and place.

In Aquarius, Uranus's themes of change, independence and experimentation are expressed through independent thinking, experimentation and concern for the wider community. In house 11 (Community & hopes), consider how this relates to friendships, groups, shared projects and your hopes for the future.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

Neptune symbolizes dreams, inspiration and the difficulty of separating an ideal from what is actually available. Its slow-moving sign is generational; its house can focus reflection on where clarity and compassion need to work together.

In Capricorn, Neptune's themes of imagination, ideals and ambiguity are expressed through patience, responsibility and a commitment to making plans tangible. In house 11 (Community & hopes), consider how this relates to friendships, groups, shared projects and your hopes for the future.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

Pluto is associated with deep change, questions of control and the rebuilding that follows an ending. Its sign belongs to a generation, so avoid treating that sign alone as a unique personality label.

In Sagittarius, Pluto's themes of power, endings and renewal are expressed through exploration, conviction and the search for a larger context. In house 9 (Beliefs & exploration), consider how this relates to higher education, travel, philosophy and the frameworks you use to make meaning.
Direct motion means the apparent zodiac longitude was increasing at birth. Read this placement together with the rest of the chart rather than as a standalone verdict.

houses.title: Self & first impressions
houses.description: House 1 concerns how you approach unfamiliar situations, present yourself and begin acting on your own behalf. With Pisces on its cusp, its symbolic approach emphasizes imagination, empathy and sensitivity to experiences that resist neat definitions. Planets in this house add their own themes; an empty house still has meaning and does not imply that this part of life is missing.

houses.title: Resources & values
houses.description: House 2 concerns money, possessions, practical security and the values that shape your use of resources. With Taurus on its cusp, its symbolic approach emphasizes steadiness, sensory awareness and a preference for building something that lasts. Planets in this house add their own themes; an empty house still has meaning and does not imply that this part of life is missing.

calculation_method: Astronomy Engine 2.1.19; geocentric apparent positions; Placidus semi-arc / Equal / Whole Sign houses.
report_note: Astrology is a symbolic tradition, not a scientific personality assessment or prediction. House positions depend on an accurate birth time. Sidereal uses a mean Lahiri model accurate to within 0.01° over 1900–2100.
